 SIGNINGS 
 K Brandon McManus is being signed, NFL Network's Mike Garafolo and Ian Rapoport reported. McManus will play his 13th NFL season after spending nine years with the Broncos, one with the Jaguars and two with the Packers, whom he played for most recently from 2024-2025. McManus and Matt Prater tried out Tuesday after the Rams placed kicker Blake Grupe on injured reserve and cut kicker Harrison Mevis last week.

 New York Giants 3-2-1 ROSTER CUTS 
 RB Najee Harris was released. Harris appeared in five games this season (one start) and totaled 99 yards on 33 carries. Harris started the Giants' Week 6 loss to the Saints, but he finished the game with just four carries for six yards.

 Tennessee Titans 1-5 ROSTER CUTS 
 DL Jordan Elliott was released after a review of an "incident" at the team facility on Oct. 15, the team announced. "Following our review of the incident, we have made the decision to release Elliott from our roster. We will have no further comment on the matter," the Titans said in a statement. Elliott had 11 tackles in five games this season.
